fullPassage: The sixteenth century Spanish novel The Adventures of Esplandian, written by Garci Rodriguez de Montalvo, describes an island paradise east of Asia called California. It is believed that this novel was the first place the word "California" appeared in print. The novel is also thought to be where the areas called California in modern-day Mexico and the United States got their names. The Adventures of Esplandian was very popular when the Spanish were exploring Mexico, and the legend of California was widely known. It seems that when Fortun Ximenez and Hernan Cortes first sailed north along the western coast, they mistook what is now called the Baja California peninsula for the fictional island and named it California. It took many years to correct the misguided belief that the peninsula was an island. By that time, California had already been well established as the name for both the peninsula and the land to its north that is now the US state.

"This novel was __________"

det.korean: the first place California appeared in print: 캘리포니아라는 단어가 활자로 나타난 최초의 장소
det.analysis:
원문: 'It is believed that this novel was the first place the word "California" appeared in print.'

• the first place (that/where) S + V: '~한 최초의 장소'라는 관계절 구조.
  - the first + 명사 + 관계절(접촉절)
• appeared in print: '활자로 나타났다' — appear + 전치사구
• California: 단어의 이름 그 자체가 주어(관계절 내에서)

7단어 완성: the / first / place / California / appeared / in / print
det.tip: the first place (where/that) S + V = ~한 최초의 장소. 관계부사/관계대명사 생략 가능(접촉절)

questions.wa: the first place California appeared in print
accept: the first place California appeared in print

questions.passage: The sixteenth century Spanish novel The Adventures of Esplandian, written by Garci Rodriguez de Montalvo, describes an island paradise east of Asia called California. It is believed that this novel was the first place the word "California" appeared in print. The novel is also thought to be where the areas called California in modern-day Mexico and the United States got their names. The Adventures of Esplandian was very popular when the Spanish were exploring Mexico, and the legend of California was widely known. It seems that when Fortun Ximenez and Hernan Cortes first sailed north along the western coast, __________ for the fictional island and named it California. It took many years to correct the misguided belief that the peninsula was an island. By that time, California had already been well established as the name for both the peninsula and the land to its north that is now the US state.

[조건] (1) called, is, mistook, now, peninsula, the, they, what를 모두 사용
(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

"__________ for the fictional island."

det.korean: They mistook what is now called the peninsula: 지금 반도라고 불리는 것을 착각했다 (8단어)
det.analysis:
원문: 'they mistook what is now called the Baja California peninsula for the fictional island'

• They mistook: 주어 + 동사(과거형). mistake의 과거형 = mistook.
• what is now called: '지금 ~라고 불리는 것' — 관계대명사 what + 수동태(is called).
  - what = the thing which. 선행사 포함 관계대명사.
  - now: 부사, '지금'. 과거 항해 시점과 현재를 대비.
• the peninsula: 목적어 보어. 바하 캘리포니아 반도를 지칭.

8단어 완성: They / mistook / what / is / now / called / the / peninsula
det.tip: what is now called X = 지금 X라고 불리는 것. what은 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사(= the thing which)

questions.wa: They mistook what is now called the peninsula
accept: They mistook what is now called the peninsula
